from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib
import pandas as pd
ROOT=Path.cwd();R='reports/research/510300_backlog_production_cause_increment_v1';OUT=ROOT/R
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def readj(p):return json.loads((ROOT/p).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def save(name,obj):
 p=OUT/name;assert not p.exists(),'已有文件不覆盖：'+name
 p.write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
leaves=readj(R+'/全部9保存叶解释.json');models=readj(R+'/保存在手订单生产十变量模型.json');mb={int(z['idx']):z for z in models}
d=pd.read_parquet(OUT/'原八字段与在手订单生产两字段_原标签不变.parquet',columns=['idx','date','stat_month','制造业生产原扩散指数','制造业在手订单原扩散指数'])
events=pd.read_csv(OUT/'两模型全部自然高分机会.csv')
prod=events[(events.model=='在手订单生产十变量')&(events.era=='2024—2025')&events.path.astype(str).str.contains('制造业生产原扩散指数',regex=False)]
assert len(prod)==4
records=[];lb={int(z['idx']):z for z in leaves}
for z in prod.itertuples(index=False):
 i=int(z.idx);l=lb[i];m=mb[i];v=d.loc[i]
 top=l['top_five_labels'];sm=sum(float(x['saved_net5']) for x in top)
 same_period=[x for x in top if '2024-09-19'<=x['decision_date']<='2024-09-25']
 assert len(same_period)==5 and v['stat_month']=='2025-04' and v['制造业生产原扩散指数']==49.8
 linked=[{'idx':x['decision_idx'],'stat_month':str(d.loc[x['decision_idx'],'stat_month']),'production_level':float(d.loc[x['decision_idx'],'制造业生产原扩散指数'])} for x in top]
 assert all(x['stat_month']=='2024-08' and x['production_level']==49.8 for x in linked)
 records.append({'signal_date':z.signal_date,'source_stat_month':str(v.stat_month),'production_level':float(v['制造业生产原扩散指数']),'backlog_level':float(v['制造业在手订单原扩散指数']),'current_actual_path':m['actual_path_features'],'mature_leaf_rows':l['mature_leaf_rows'],'saved_prediction':l['saved_positive_prediction'],'saved_net5':l['saved_net_event_return'],'five_largest_original_labels':top,'five_labels_current_month_states':linked,'five_label_sum':sm,'five_overlap_positive_share':sm/l['positive_label_sum'],'five_overlap_signed_sum_share':sm/l['signed_label_sum'],'share_not_probability_causal_or_independent_sample_count':True})
supp={'experiment_id':'E52','computed_at':now(),'status':'COMPLETED_ALL_FOUR_PRODUCTION_HIGH_PATHS_SAME_VALUE_DIFFERENT_MONTHS_AND_OVERLAPPING_LABEL_CONCENTRATION','original_primary_events_kept':9,'production_path_events':4,'current_production_month':'2025-04','original_positive_labels_production_month':'2024-08','both_original_production_levels':49.8,'five_overlapping_label_signed_sum_share_range':[min(z['five_overlap_signed_sum_share'] for z in records),max(z['five_overlap_signed_sum_share'] for z in records)],'records':records,'economic_cause_of_equal_production_states':'NOT_IDENTIFIED_BY_SAME_LEVEL_OR_RETURN_LABEL','September_policy_single_causal_return':'NOT_IDENTIFIED','no_labels_deleted_or_refitted':True,'new_fits':0,'new_labels':0,'new_accounts':0,'new_sources':0,'source_code_edits':0,'goal_achieved':False}
save('四生产路径同值与原重叠标签贡献.json',supp)
report=OUT/'固定失败归因_信号费用与原叶.md';report.write_text(report.read_text(encoding='utf-8')+f"\n四条生产高分实际都对应2025年4月原生产49.8、在手订单43.2；每个原成熟叶的前五大正标签均是2024年9月19—25日决定的重叠五日窗口，彼时原生产值也为2024年8月49.8。这五个原标签占各叶带符号收益合计{supp['five_overlapping_label_signed_sum_share_range'][0]:.6%}—{supp['five_overlapping_label_signed_sum_share_range'][1]:.6%}。这是同值状态与标签贡献事实，不证明两个月份调整原因相同、不把五个重叠标签叫五个独立政策机会，也不识别九月单政策因果收益。原四条预测/正负结果/全部九机会都保留，拒绝不变。完整记录见[同值与重叠贡献](四生产路径同值与原重叠标签贡献.json)。\n",encoding='utf-8')
nextq={'experiment_id':'E53','status':'PROPOSED_EQUAL_PRODUCTION_VALUE_DIFFERENT_ORIGINAL_CAUSES_AND_DECISION_INFORMATION_NOT_REGISTERED_NOT_RUN','proposed_at':now(),'question':'2024-08和2025-04原生产扩散指数同为49.8，其调整原因与原决定前公开信息是否不同，能否解释E51在四生产路径上把九月重叠上涨经验迁到五月？','fixed_objects':['2024-08原PMI及已有解释','2025-04原PMI及已有解释','E51主期全部四生产实际路径和全部九自然机会作为原背景'],'economic_role':'同指标数值不识别需求、供应约束或政策信息的共同原因；先找原官方明确解释与决定时可知不同信息，不由未来收益推因，不预设四月是关税或八月是天气。','method':'先在E37/E38、旧指数2025Q2贸易/政策链、E47/E48及已存原源核实际用途；绑定原当月字段调整及公告发布时间/决定、明确原因引用/同期背景/UNKNOWN分开。不重复旧来源研究成新alpha，只形成不同月份同值的具体信息差桥。没有独立新原因证据则结束。','existing_sources':['reports/research/510300_purchase_adjustment_current_report_cause_review_v1/result.json','reports/research/510300_official_pmi_interpretation_cause_source_qualification_v1/result.json','reports/research/510300_historical_index_us_rates_trade_q2_v1/result.json','reports/research/510300_extreme_leaf_policy_information_clock_v1/result.json','reports/research/510300_policy_press_preview_information_clock_v1/result.json',R+'/四生产路径同值与原重叠标签贡献.json'],'budget_proposed':{'new_network_requests':0,'new_models':0,'new_fits':0,'new_labels':0,'new_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0},'stop':'只是原原因/可知性解释，不重开E51、删极端标签、调整阈值/周期/字段/模型；若已有相同信息或原原因没明确，不强分原因，不拟合。','new_model_protocol_required_for_future_genuinely_distinct_information':True,'full_goal_preserved':True,'goal_achieved':False,'net_sharpe':'NOT_COMPUTED','current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','live_process':False}
save('next_experiment.json',nextq)
print(json.dumps({'原四生产状态':'2025-04生产49.8；原最大五标签对应2024-08同49.8','九月五重叠标签占带符号叶收益':supp['five_overlapping_label_signed_sum_share_range'],'下一E53':'仅同值异因原源/可知性提案，未登记未执行','新拟合':0},ensure_ascii=False))
